reason: A DeepSeek Harness tool plugin that delegates text processing and image analysis or OCR to a locally running Unsloth Desktop service through authenticated HTTP calls.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的文本处理和图像分析或 OCR 任务交给本地运行的 Unsloth Desktop 服务处理。
summaries.en: Delegates text processing and image analysis or OCR tasks from DeepSeek Harness to a locally running Unsloth Desktop service.

capabilities: Sends text prompts to a locally running Unsloth Desktop HTTP API
Sends images from local paths, URLs, or conversation attachments for vision processing
Registers text and vision tools for the DeepSeek Harness agent
Uses an API key for authenticated requests
